risks.risk: Whether the machine head actually works (timing, needle movement, feed mechanism).
risks.proof: Short video of the machine running with a needle moving and fabric feed (or a hand-crank/treadle test) plus a close-up of the stitch/needle movement.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working (worst case: needs service/repair).

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (flat plate and other “complete set” items).
risks.proof: Photo(s) laying out every included accessory on a table, with a checklist matching the seller’s list.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete set (worst case: only the machine/stand).

risks.risk: Model/serial unknown, which affects parts availability and value.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the model/serial plate on the machine head (and any stamped numbers).
risks.if_unproven: Priced without model premium (worst case: generic/unknown vintage value).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in this single wide shot (rust, bent parts, worn gears/belt, cracked cabinet).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: needle area, feed dogs, handwheel teeth, underside/treadle area, and any rust spots.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the machine’s model/serial plate (numbers readable).
Video showing the machine operating (needle movement + feed) and a simple stitch result.
Photos of all accessories laid out, matching the seller’s “complete set” list (including the flat plate).
Close-ups of key wear points (needle plate area, feed mechanism, handwheel/gear condition, and any rust).
response.reason: The photo shows a vintage Singer-style treadle sewing machine on a stand, but the key value drivers (exact model, confirmed working condition, and whether the full accessory set is included) are not verifiable from the single image. Request proof before pricing.
